Slushy!|t6=''Primary profession dependent skill''}} During this quest, you will be in [[The Great Snowball Fight of the Gods]] area, and all party members will be under the effects of [[Godly Yuletide]] and have the Godly Yuletide [[skill bar]] (with [[Avalanche (skill)|Avalanche]] instead of [[Yellow Snow]]), and dead players are resurrected at a shrine every 30 seconds at the top or bottom of the minute. The mission's objective is to kill the Balthazar and Grenth beacons, and protect yours. When you kill a Champion or a General you will receive a [[Morale Boost]]. You can teleport between your beacons, but you will suffer from the [[Portal Sickness]] effect. ==NPCs== ===Allies=== [[Dwayna]] * {{w}} or {{r}} 15 (20) [[Bustling Snowman]] * {{mo}} 30 [[Champion of Dwayna]] * {{mo}} 15 (20) [[Cordial Snowman]] * {{me}} 15 (20) [[Glimmering Snowman]] * {{e}} 15 (20) [[Chilled Snowman]] * {{rt}} 15 (20) [[Industrious Snowman]] * {{d}} 15 (20) [[Blessed Snowman]] * {{x}} 26 [[Beacon of Dwayna]] [[Melandru]] * {{w}} 15 (20) [[Jingle Bear (snowball)|Jingle Bear]] * {{r}} 30 [[Champion of Melandru]] * {{r}} 15 (20) [[Jingle Moa]] * {{me}} 15 (20) [[Festive Iboga]] * {{e}} 15 (20) [[Merry Jacaranda]] * {{a}} 15 (20) [[Melandru's Stalker (snowball)|Melandru's Stalker]] * {{rt}} 15 (20) [[Melandru's Watcher]] * {{x}} 26 [[Beacon of Melandru]] ===Foes=== [[Balthazar]] * {{w}} 30 [[Champion of Balthazar]] * {{w}} 15 (20) [[Eternal Warrior]] * {{w}} 24 [[General of Balthazar]] * {{r}} 15 (20) [[Eternal Ranger]] * {{mo}} 15 (20) [[Eternal Monk]] * {{n}} 15 (20) [[Eternal Necromancer]] * {{me}} 15 (20) [[Eternal Mesmer]] * {{e}} 15 (20) [[Eternal Elementalist]] * {{p}} 15 (20) [[Eternal Paragon]] * {{x}} 26 [[Beacon of Balthazar]] [[Grenth]] * {{w}} 15 (20) [[Bruiser Grentch]] * {{r}} 15 (20) [[Humbug]] * {{n}} 30 [[Champion of Grenth]] * {{n}} 24 [[General of Balthazar]] * {{n}} 15 (20) [[Voice of Grenth]] * {{me}} 15 (20) [[Mind of Grenth]] * {{e}} 15 (20) [[Chill of Grenth]] * {{rt}} 15 (20) [[Shepherd of Grenth]] * {{d}} 15 (20) [[Harvester of Grenth]] * {{x}} 26 [[Beacon of Grenth]] ==Dialogue== ===Initial dialogue=== ;Priestess of Melandru :''"The Priests of Balthazar are quite upset, it seems. They sense grave danger on the horizon, and while we have sensed this as well, we do not feel that crushing the spirit of the local population is the best way to prepare. Of course, the Priests of Balthazar have been less than receptive to our alternative solutions."'' :''"Against our better judgment, we have agreed to meet them in battle with all forces we can muster, so we can show the residents of Tyria once and for all that, with hope and camaraderie, we can survive anything. If you wish to serve Dwayna and Melandru, speak with Melandru's Watcher. Should you wish to join forces with Grenth and Balthazar, you should speak with the Champion of Balthazar. Both can be found in either the [[Temple of the Ages|Temple of Ages]] {{sic}} or the Chantry of Secrets."'' {{ Offer dialog | accept = I pledge my support to the forces of Dwayna and Melandru. | decline = Fight against the combined armies of the God of War and the God of Death? (sent to [[The Great Snowball Fight of the Gods]]) :{{no|ingame}} '''We need more time to prepare.''' ==Notes== *It is also possible to enter from [[Zin Ku Corridor]]. The quest marker will point there while in Cantha. *Technically, this quest cannot be completed. Fulfilling the objectives, and obtaining the reward, will not remove the quest entry from your log. This allows you to reenter the fight immediately without having to talk to the quest giver again. ==Trivia== *This quest was introduced in [[Wintersday 2010]]. **In [[Wintersday 2011]] the bonus for protecting your own Champions and Beacons was added and the time limits for the bonuses were diminished from 10, 20, and 30 minutes to 5, 10, and 20 minutes. *The quest's name is a reference to the lyrics of the song [[w:Winter Wonderland|Winter Wonderland]]. *This quest is based off of the popular player-made Warcraft III map '[[w:Defense of the Ancients|Defense of the Ancients]]'. ==See also== *[[Operation: Crush Spirits]] {{minigames nav}} [[Category:Prophecies quests]] [[Category:Prophecies festival quests]] [[Category:Prophecies minigames]] [[Category:Nightfall quests]] [[Category:Nightfall festival quests]] [[Category:Nightfall minigames]] [[Category:Wintersday 2010 quests]]
